agents_spawned.task_context: Refine issue #1032: Agent anchor mechanism for post-compaction state recovery. This is a new feature that adds persistent state files (.egg-state/agent-anchors/) so agents can recover coherently after context compaction. The issue has a detailed proposed design with YAML anchor files, update triggers, and post-compaction injection. Key areas to refine: (1) Resolve the 6 design questions in the issue (format, size budget, update mechanism, conflict resolution, cleanup, gateway enforcement). (2) Define the anchor schema precisely - what fields are required vs optional, validation rules. (3) Specify the post-compaction injection mechanism - how anchors get loaded into context, ordering, size limits. (4) Define the team-level anchor schema and how it relates to individual agent anchors. (5) Identify integration points with existing systems (egg-contract, checkpoint, message bus from #1027). (6) Specify acceptance criteria as testable requirements. Read the issue with 'gh issue view 1032' for full context. Check existing code in .egg-state/ and shared/ directories for patterns to follow. Output refined requirements to .egg-state/drafts/.
